padding: Append fixed zero trits to low/full local codewords until length 48, then differential-map all trits from seed. Padding is known, ignored on decode, exposed to noise and fully charged. No parity correction is added.
constraint_gate: max whole-strand homopolymer <=2 and whole-strand GC in [0.45,0.55] for all three detectors on each source identity. A failed identity excludes all three detector versions, not one. No replacement search.
clean_gate: All matched candidates must exactly recover every included clean source before noisy interpretation; stop on failure.
analysis: Keep all tested copy budgets and failure counts, stratify by size, record excluded identities and mutation fractions; fixed-geometry detector-allocation comparison, not optimized cross-codec frontier or physical validation.
approval_scope: Private scientific preparation only; production code and user verdict gate unchanged.
